newsitem.title: Austria: Austrian shares close firmer, further gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close firmer, further gains seen.

text.p: 1415 GMT - Austrian shares close firmer on Tuesday amid strong buying across the board and traders expect further gains as the Austrian Traded Index broke resistance at 1,217 points.
* 13 ATX shares higher, six lower, two unchanged.
* March ATX future up 14.0 points at 1,228.0.
* Leading gainer Creditanstalt preferred, up 4.17 pct at 450 schillings.
* Leading decliner VA Stahl down 1.23 pct at 474.1 schillings -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 257
